description: This file defines the CommentForm class in Drupal, handling comment form rendering, validation, preview, and saving logic within the Drupal CMS.

classes.name: CommentForm
classes.description: A form handler class for managing comment forms, including rendering, validation, preview, and submission logic within Drupal.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate CommentForm with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies such as entity repository, current user, renderer, entity type bundle info, time service, and entity field manager.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the comment form with fields for author info, comment content, and administrative options, considering user permissions and context.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions including submit, preview, and disables delete; manages button visibility based on permissions and preview mode.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Constructs the comment entity from form input, setting timestamps, author info, and default subject if necessary.

methods.name: getEditedFieldNames
methods.description: Returns list of field names that are editable, including 'created' and 'name'.

methods.name: flagViolations
methods.description: Flags validation violations for 'created' and 'name' fields.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Handles comment preview rendering, avoiding infinite loops by cloning the entity and hiding comment fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the comment entity, logs actions, and redirects to the comment or entity page, with permission checks.

methods.name: getStatusMessage
methods.description: Generates a status message after comment save, indicating whether it is queued, posted, or updated.
